calibration.note: validation split does not contain classes ['Neutral-Cool']; raw probabilities kept (calibration requires every class to appear in the calibration data)

selection_reason.note: highest person-grouped CV macro_f1 over the same folds; heuristic baseline kept separately as model zero

ablation.note: same folds/backend for every variant; the full set stays the deployed default unless a variant wins by a margin worth acting on
